scenarios.title: Consumer mobile banking transfer
scenarios.prompt: Design a repeat transfer to a saved beneficiary. Show amount, fees, debit account, recipient verification, review and a timeout after submission. History can query transfer status but a timeout does not tell whether money moved.

fixture.existing_system: Existing native controls, ledger typography, semantic status colors and small control radii; no restyling.

criteria: Recipient and total are explicit before commitment.
Unknown result leads to status reconciliation before retry.
Touch, native keyboard and focus intent are specified.
Receipt reflects actual result and supports return to history.

scenarios.deliverable: Task and information model; system mapping; interaction/state contract; responsive and input behavior; rationale, critique and evidence limits.
